summary: Kisin, Pappas and Zhou construct integral models of Shimura varieties of abelian type with parahoric level at every odd prime, étale locally isomorphic to the local models and with a local-model diagram (Theorem 7.2.21). The paper also corrects a gap in Kisin–Pappas 2018: the connection isomorphism behind the tensor deformation argument needs a very good Hodge embedding, and §§4–6 show such embeddings exist in enough cases, through a curve-spanning theorem for tangent spaces of affine Schubert varieties. Complete (cc-442dc5): every numbered statement is an item, every missing item is routed exactly once, and fourteen findings are recorded. Seven are the paper's printed corrections of Kisin–Pappas 2018 and Pappas 2023. In characteristic p the proof of Proposition 4.2.10(2) is incomplete (E9), though Theorem 4.2.3 stands. Not formalised.

items.name: Quasi-tame reductive group
items.statement: A reductive K-group is quasi-tame if it is a product of Res_(K_i/K)H_i for finite K_i/K with each H_i splitting over a tamely ramified extension of K_i. The extensions K_i/K themselves may be wild.

api.statement: Record the finite field extensions, factors and tame splitting fields.

api.name: KPZ.D04.characterise
api.statement: Distinguish quasi-tame from tamely split over K.

api.name: KPZ.D04.map
api.statement: Products and the stated additional restriction of scalars preserve the presentation.

uses.how: A product of Res_{K_i/K}T_i with each T_i a tamely split torus is R-smooth, even when K_i/K is wildly ramified.

The standard assumptions are p>2, (G,{μ}) of local abelian type, G essentially tame (G_ad quasi-tame), and G classical, excluding trialitarian D4. The local groups of global abelian-type data satisfy these restrictions.

items.name: Root-datum minuscule weight
items.statement: A weight ω is minuscule if |<α∨,ω>|≤1 for every root α. This is an integral root-datum condition, distinct from the pinned characteristic-zero Lie-module predicate with the same English name.

items.statement: The functor R09 is represented by a projective k-scheme, is positive-loop-group invariant and contains S_μ as a closed subscheme. The reduced-equality remark is not needed for the tangent arguments.

items.name: Canonical comparison over a frame with enlarged ideal
items.statement: Let F = (S, I, φ, φ_1) be a frame with frame morphisms D_k → F → D_k (the second ι) composing to the identity, let I′ be the kernel of S → W(k) → k, and suppose I ⊂ I′ and φ_1 extends to φ′_1: I′ → S, so that F′ = (S, I′, φ, φ′_1) is a frame. For a pair (M, M_1) over F with an isomorphism ψ: M_0 ⊗_{W(k)} S → M whose base change along ι is the identity, there is an isomorphism c_S: M̃_{0,1} ⊗_{W(k)} S → M̃_1 of finite free S-modules (5.1.12), functorial in (M, M_1, ψ) and compatible with base change.

items.name: Multiplier exact sequences for a Hodge-type group
items.statement: Let (G, X) be of Hodge type with G^ad simple, G^c the subgroup generated by G^der and the largest compact subtorus Z_{G,0} of Z_G, and Z^c_G the subgroup generated by Z_{G^der} and Z_{G,0}. Then 1 → G^c → G → G_m → 1 and 1 → Z^c_G → Z_G → G_m → 1 are exact, the maps to G_m being the symplectic multiplier of some (equivalently any) Hodge embedding.
